verdict.rationale: The closest evidence is org-wide central configuration: one `.coderabbit.yaml` in a dedicated repository governs every repository. There is also a cross-repository Triage queue with filters, grouping and saved views for working through many PRs, but its documented actions (review, repair, reassign, merge, close) are described per pull request, not as multi-select bulk operations. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/multi-select actions across many PRs or repos, a documented batch API or CLI for mass operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
